ucs.title: [LLM] Black Basta IT-helpdesk impersonation: Quick Assist / AnyDesk spawn chain after Teams social engineering
ucs.description: Hunts the 2024-onwards Black Basta (aka UNC4393 / Storm-1811 affiliate set) initial-access pattern: email-bombing victim, then Teams chat from an impersonated IT helpdesk, then Quick Assist remote-control followed by AnyDesk/ScreenConnect install and PowerShell/curl fetch of the loader. Quickassist.exe spawning a shell or downloader is near-zero in benign telemetry and is the signature pivot for this crew.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_name) as child from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="quickassist.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="QuickAssist.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","msiexec.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*anydesk*","*screenconnect*","*ScreenConnect.ClientSetup*","*DownloadString*","*Invoke-WebRequest*","*New-Object Net.WebClient*","*IEX*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="SYSTEM" AND user!="LOCAL SERVICE" | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "quickassist.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","msiexec.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("anydesk","screenconnect","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","Net.WebClient","IEX(","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith_cs "quickassist.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith_cs "QuickAssist.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","msiexec.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
   or CommandLine has_any ("anydesk","screenconnect","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","Net.WebClient","IEX(","-EncodedCommand")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Black Basta Quick Assist Spawning Shell or Remote-Access Installer
id: 0c0c5e92-7c1a-4d2f-9d44-b3ea2b8b3a51
status: experimental
description: Detects quickassist.exe parenting a scripting host, downloader, or remote-access tool installer (AnyDesk / ScreenConnect) — the Black Basta / Storm-1811 helpdesk-impersonation initial-access chain.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2024/05/15/threat-actors-misusing-quick-assist-in-social-engineering-attacks-leading-to-ransomware/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\quickassist.exe'
  child_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  child_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'anydesk'
      - 'screenconnect'
      - 'ScreenConnect.ClientSetup'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'IEX('
  condition: parent and (child_shell or child_cmdline)
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned helpdesk sessions where an IT analyst guides the user through troubleshooting commands
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1566.004
  - attack.t1059.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\quickassist.exe OR *\\QuickAssist.exe OR *\\QUICKASSIST.EXE) AND (@Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*anydesk* OR *AnyDesk* OR *screenconnect* OR *ScreenConnect* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *EncodedCommand*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/quickassist\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|curl|certutil|bitsadmin|msiexec|mshta|rundll32|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i OR regex("(anydesk|screenconnect|ScreenConnect\.ClientSetup|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|Net\.WebClient|IEX\(|EncodedCommand)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Quick Assist (quickassist.exe) is a built-in Windows tool. In legitimate use it does not spawn shells, downloaders, or remote-access tool installers. Microsoft (Storm-1811), Rapid7, and ReliaQuest all directly attribute the quickassist.exe → cmd/PowerShell → AnyDesk/ScreenConnect chain to Black Basta affiliates in 2024-2025 intrusions, distinguishing it from Akira / LockBit / Play. ucs.title: [LLM] Black Basta service-execution detonation: PsExec / SCM remote service + shadow-copy & boot-recovery destruction
ucs.description: Hunts the final-stage Black Basta ransomware detonation pattern: PSEXESVC (or a remote service installed via SCM) launching encryptor binaries, immediately followed by vssadmin shadow deletion, wbadmin catalog delete, and bcdedit boot-recovery sabotage. This sequencing — service execution chained with the same destruction quartet — is the Black Basta playbook documented by CISA #StopRansomware AA24-131A.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR Processes.process_name="PSEXESVC.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="PSEXESVC.exe" OR (Processes.parent_process_name="services.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*")) ) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats values(process_name) as procs values(process) as cmdlines dc(process_name) as distinct_actions min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by host user | where distinct_actions >= 2 | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Recovery = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","safeboot","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let ServiceExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "PSEXESVC.exe"
         or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "services.exe" and FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
union Recovery, ServiceExec
| summarize EventCount = count(),
            DistinctActions = dcount(FileName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 25),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Parents  = make_set(ParentName, 10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctActions >= 2     // chain of 2+ recovery/service-exec actions on same host == Black Basta detonation
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Recovery = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith_cs "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith_cs "wmic.exe"     and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith_cs "wbadmin.exe"  and CommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith_cs "bcdedit.exe"  and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","safeboot","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let ServiceExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith_cs "PSEXESVC.exe"
         or (ParentProcessName endswith_cs "services.exe" and NewProcessName has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
union Recovery, ServiceExec
| summarize EventCount = count(),
            DistinctActions = dcount(NewProcessName),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            Binaries = make_set(NewProcessName, 25),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            Parents  = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 AND ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\Vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\Wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete*catalog*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled*no* OR *safeboot* OR *bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*)) OR @ParentImage:(*\\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\\psexesvc.exe OR *\\PSEXESVC.EXE) OR (@ParentImage:(*\\services.exe OR *\\Services.exe) AND @Image:(*\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\*)) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ( (ImageFileName=/vssadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("delete.+shadows", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
    OR (ImageFileName=/wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("shadowcopy.+delete", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
    OR (ImageFileName=/wbadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("delete.+catalog", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
    OR (ImageFileName=/bcdedit\.exe$/i AND regex("(recoveryenabled\s+no|safeboot|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
    OR ParentBaseFileName=/psexesvc\.exe/i
    OR (ParentBaseFileName=/services\.exe/i AND regex("\\\\(Windows\\\\Temp|PerfLogs|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData)\\\\", field=ImageFileName, flags="i")) )
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]) | min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen) | max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen) | count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctActions) })
| DistinctActions >= 2
ucs.rationale: CISA AA24-131A and Mandiant (UNC4393) call out this exact sequence as the Black Basta detonation signature: PsExec or SCM-staged remote service launches the encryptor from C:\Windows\Temp / PerfLogs, followed by vssadmin delete shadows, wbadmin delete catalog, and bcdedit /set safeboot.
